clauses.requirement: Reversing projector (RP), para 5.12.6 failure provisions: no requirement applies (no failure provisions are specified for the reversing projector).
Reversing projector (RP), para 5.12.7 colour: the colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
Conformity of production (UN R148 para 6): lamps shall comply with the conformity of production provisions of paragraph 6 and its sub-paragraphs.
Lamps shall be manufactured so as to conform to the type approved under UN R148; compliance with the requirements of paragraph 5 shall be verified as set out in paragraphs 6.1.1 to 6.1.3.
For conformity of production, the minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 4 shall be complied with.
For conformity of production, the minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 5 shall be complied with.

For conformity of production, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in the Regulation; for the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12.

Table 12 CoP values: for minimum photometric values required throughout the fields of Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values shall meet the equivalent 20 per cent and 30 per cent values: required minimum 7·10^-1 cd -> 5·10^-1 (20%) and 3·10^-1 (30%); 6·10^-1 -> 4·10^-1 and 2·10^-1; 3·10^-1 -> 2·10^-1 and 1·10^-1; 7·10^-2 -> 5·10^-2 and 3·10^-2; 5·10^-2 -> 3·10^-2 and 2·10^-2 cd.
